A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the TeV scale seesaw mechanism is a promising scenario for understanding the origin of the small neutrino masses and mixing, while the low scale extra dimension scenario may be ruled out if no new physics signals at LHC are observed.

TeV scale models of neutrino masses are very attractive in that they can explain all of the neutrino data and can also provide a rich variety of phenomenology at colliders and in low energy experiments.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the TeV scale models can provide an explanation of the observed neutrino masses without the need to introduce new scales of physics beyond the electroweak scale.
TeV scale physics is not necessarily excluded by neutrino mass bounds.
